{{Spoiler}}

'''Gnocchi''' is a secret potato pasta that heals {{Value|Gnocchi|heals}}, tied with [[stroganoff]] for the most healing of any crafted meal. It has no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/gnocchi.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[Baked Potato|baked potato]], [[cheese]], an egg, [[flour]] and a [[bowl]]. The recipe is taught by a [[Cooking Recipe]] found in mineshaft chests.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating gnocchi takes {{Value|Gnocchi|eat_time}} and heals {{Value|Gnocchi|heals}}. The bowl is given back. Making it grants ''Wait, you can make that?''

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_15.mcfunction|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>
